lines.t: (Atmospheric guitar + low bass pulse)
Rise up and stand between me and the ones who hunt
Take the shield, take the spear, make the path they walk shut
Speak to the quiet place inside my chest
Tell it the war is already won, that I’m kept
They set the trap with no reason, dug the hole with no cause
Let the snare they planted close around their own jaws
Scatter them like dry leaves when the storm begins to run
Let the messenger of justice chase them till they’re done
How long will You just watch from the edge of the fight?
Pull my life from the teeth before they close tight
My soul will sing when the morning breaks through
Every bone will cry out, “There is no one like You”
You pull the weak from the grip of the strong
You turn the plunderer’s hand, You right every wrong
When they were broken I wore the sackcloth and ash
I treated their pain like it belonged to my own flesh
I walked like a brother, I bowed like a son
But the second I stumbled they gathered as one
False tongues rise up asking questions I never knew
They trade me darkness for the light that I showed them true
They feast on my falling, they grind their teeth in delight
While I stand in the open asking You to make it right
How long will You just watch from the edge of the fight?
Pull my life from the teeth before they close tight
My soul will sing when the morning breaks through
Every bone will cry out, “There is no one like You”
You pull the weak from the grip of the strong
You turn the plunderer’s hand, You right every wrong
Let their road grow black and slick beneath their feet
Let the one who watches over justice never retreat
I will stand in the crowd and lift Your name out loud
I will thank You where the many gather and the silence breaks down
My soul will sing when the morning breaks through
Every bone will cry out, “There is no one like You”
You pull the weak from the grip of the strong
You turn the plunderer’s hand, You right every wrong
[Outro]
( guitars swell, then pull back to single sustained note )
Tell the quiet place inside…
You are the one who saves
